sources.E: Exophase — GTA VI PS5 trophy list
sources.O: Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List guide (Nov 19, 2026)

trophies.description: Congratulations! You're a Leonida Legend.
trophies.guide: Plan on roughly 200 hours: the story is the short part, and the 100% checklist plus the long counters eat the clock (PowerPyx). This pops on its own the moment the other 54 are yours (Exophase).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.description: Complete Gone Fishing.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you finish Gone Fishing (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you finish Chapter 1 (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 2.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you finish Chapter 2 (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Tits, Ass, Drug Money

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 3.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you finish Chapter 3 (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: A Tale of Two Sons

trophies.description: Complete Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you finish Chapter 4 (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: All Downhill From Here

trophies.description: Complete the final mission of the game.
trophies.guide: Keep a manual save before the final mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game+ (PowerPyx). The trophy lands when the final mission ends (Exophase).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.description: Arrive in Leonida.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you arrive in Leonida (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Welcome to Leonida

trophies.description: Take over the H&H Warehouse.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you take over the H&H Warehouse (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: In The Beginning...

trophies.description: Take control of the Vice City Stock Exchange.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you take control of the Vice City Stock Exchange (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Survive the Marabunta Grande ambush.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you survive the Marabunta Grande ambush (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.description: Discover what is hidden in Mount Gordo.
trophies.guide: Story-locked and automatic: it lands when you discover what is hidden in Mount Gordo (Exophase). No mission replay exists, so keep a manual save at the chapter start (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Escape a 6 star wanted level.
trophies.guide: Reach a 6-star wanted level, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear (Output Lag).
trophies.name: In Plain Sight

trophies.description: Attain 100% Completion.
trophies.guide: The checklist appears under Progress > Stats after the story (Output Lag). It asks for about 60% of true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, collect 50 of 66 weapons and finish 70 of 80 Challenges (PowerPyx). Some categories must be complete in full: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests (PowerPyx). PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy in the game (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.description: Complete 250 Stunts.
trophies.guide: Any stunt counts — jumps, flips and near misses all register (Output Lag). The trophy wants 250; the 100% checklist separately wants 300, so keep going after this pops (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types, one try each: the game tracks which types you have touched in the Activities menu (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold on every range challenge — 42 in all (Exophase). The ranges must also be completed in full for the 100% checklist (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Race a drone in every location.
trophies.guide: One drone race in each of the 14 locations (Exophase). Drone Races are one of the categories the 100% checklist requires in full (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Drone On

trophies.description: Win every type of race.
trophies.guide: Win one race of every type — road, off-road, water and air all count separately (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Racing Line

trophies.description: Play a game with the VR headset.
trophies.guide: The VR headset game is playable once Vice City opens up in Chapter 3 (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Eyes Wide Shut

trophies.description: Rob a store with your partner.
trophies.guide: Partner play unlocks in Chapter 2; rob any store with Jason and Lucia together (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Show Me The Money

trophies.description: Complete all of Andy's side story missions.
trophies.guide: Story-locked: it lands when you finish all of Andy's side story missions (Exophase). This strand stays available after the credits — finish it in cleanup if you pass it by (Output Lag). Andy's strand is Lucia-only (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Heartbreaker

trophies.description: Complete all of Kenton's side story missions.
trophies.guide: Story-locked: it lands when you finish all of Kenton's side story missions (Exophase). This strand stays available after the credits — finish it in cleanup if you pass it by (Output Lag).
trophies.name: King of the Hill

trophies.description: Complete all of Billy's side story missions.
trophies.guide: Story-locked: it lands when you finish all of Billy's side story missions (Exophase). This strand stays available after the credits — finish it in cleanup if you pass it by (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Billy's Hill

trophies.description: Complete all Strangers and Freaks strands.
trophies.guide: Eight strands to close out (Exophase). Andy's strand is Lucia-only, while Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only (PowerPyx). Hourglass-marked quests can expire, but they do not count toward trophies (PowerPyx). The Irredeemable profile choice cannot be undone once made (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete all of Randy's side story missions.
trophies.guide: Story-locked: it lands when you finish all of Randy's side story missions (Exophase). This strand stays available after the credits — finish it in cleanup if you pass it by (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Collector

trophies.description: Complete all of Bret's hunt.
trophies.guide: Story-locked: it lands when you finish all of Bret's hunt (Exophase). This strand stays available after the credits — finish it in cleanup if you pass it by (Output Lag). Bret's hunt is Jason-only (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Hunt for Red

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 18 spots across 10 locations; meditate with both characters where a spot allows it (PowerPyx). THE MISSABLE: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia is at Jason's house in the morning — follow her to the balcony and meditate before Chapter 1 ends (PowerPyx). PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that meditation is required, but it costs a minute to do (PowerPyx). The final spot needs both characters, so it opens only after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 (PowerPyx). Push Square reports no known missables; we flag this one anyway (Push Square).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Play every type of activity in the game with your partner.
trophies.guide: Every activity type once with your partner beside you — partner play runs from Chapter 2 on (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Leonida Local

trophies.description: Complete a full set of Leonida's Finest cards in every category.
trophies.guide: Three full sets of Leonida's Finest, one in every category (Exophase).
trophies.name: Trading Places

trophies.description: Take 100 photos of Points of Interest using the WAiNK app.
trophies.guide: Photograph Points of Interest with the WAiNK app; the counter in the app tracks your 100 (Output Lag).
trophies.name: WAiNK On

trophies.description: Challenge yourself and complete 50 Challenges.
trophies.guide: The trophy lands at 50 Challenges; the 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so the ten hardest can be skipped (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Challenge Accepted

trophies.description: Dance with your partner at a club.
trophies.guide: From Chapter 2, take your partner dancing at any club (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Good Times

trophies.description: Get a haircut with your partner.
trophies.guide: From Chapter 2, sit for a haircut with your partner present (Output Lag).
trophies.name: On Thin Ice

trophies.description: Scan 100 vehicles using the WAiNK app.
trophies.guide: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app from the first hour (PowerPyx). The trophy wants 100; the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning new models (PowerPyx).
trophies.name: Jack of all Trades

trophies.description: Kill 5 people in 5 seconds with your sidearm while in Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Enter Combat Focus with L3+R3 while aiming, then drop 5 people in 5 seconds with your sidearm (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Steal an airplane.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet hooked to a boarding bridge at Vice City International — gates E3 and E4 are the reliable spots (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.description: Destroy a tank with another tank.
trophies.guide: Rhino tanks patrol Mile Zero Air Station in the far southwest; arrive in a tank of your own and trade fire (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Steal a safe's contents without raising an alarm.
trophies.guide: From Chapter 3, run Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs for the Snap Gun, then work Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds through the back door and read the safe-code note before touching the safe (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.description: Rob 5 bank vaults.
trophies.guide: Bank vaults unlock through the optional mission That's Where The Money Is near the end of Chapter 4; rob any five (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Launder Money

trophies.description: Become an enemy of the state.
trophies.guide: Sustain the maximum wanted level until the state treats you as its enemy — a long 6-star rampage does it (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Leonida Legend

trophies.description: Explore all areas in Leonida.
trophies.guide: 52 named areas to set foot in; the map greys out the ones still missing (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Land and Sea

trophies.description: Kill a member of every gang in Leonida.
trophies.guide: One confirmed kill on a member of each of the nine gangs (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Reaper

trophies.description: Discover the Secret Spot.
trophies.guide: The Secret Spot is a hidden location found during Chapter 1's free roam (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Paradise Found

trophies.description: Complete a side quest with both Jason and Lucia.
trophies.guide: Finish one side quest with Jason and another with Lucia (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The King and The Queen

trophies.description: Hunt a Legendary animal.
trophies.guide: Legendary animals appear at fixed hunting grounds once their rumors unlock (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Big Game Hunter

trophies.description: Improve yourself.
trophies.guide: The guides disagree, so both readings are printed: PowerPyx reads this as maxing Strength on both characters (PowerPyx); Push Square reads it as reaching max body fat, the Overweight build (Push Square). Neither is confirmed yet.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.description: Make a choice.
trophies.guide: The game's own hint is 'Choices made (for better or worse)'. PowerPyx warns the Irredeemable profile choice cannot be undone once made (PowerPyx). The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by any guide.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The game's own hint is 'Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley'. PowerPyx reads it as stealing three valuables inside the alley (PowerPyx). Unconfirmed — no guide has verified the method yet.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The game's own hint is 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'. PowerPyx reads it as knocking 10 pedestrians off a bike within 60 seconds (PowerPyx). Unconfirmed — no guide has verified the method yet.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Rob a bank.
trophies.guide: Any full bank robbery counts — the Chapter 4 vault jobs are the natural place (Output Lag).
trophies.name: The Big One

trophies.guide: Push your earnings to $250,000 total; vault payouts after Chapter 4 move this fastest (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Mo' Money, No Problems

trophies.guide: Your first $100,000 across all income; story payouts alone get you most of the way (Output Lag).
trophies.name: First Dollar

trophies.description: Own 8 garages.
trophies.guide: Garages are bought in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; all eight run about $160,000 total (Output Lag).
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app opens through the Chapter 2 mission Moses; register any ten vehicles you own (Output Lag).
trophies.name: On the Spot
